problem: The note on node b is '¬p∨q', but only the p→q part is rewritten. The whole formula after removing the implication is (¬p∨q)∧(p∨q). As drawn, the box silently drops the (p∨q) factor, so it is not equivalent to the box above it, and the caption 'Every box is logically equivalent to the one above it' becomes false.
fix: Change node b's note to '(¬p∨q)∧(p∨q)'. Then node c '(¬p∧p)∨q' follows correctly by factoring q.
